messages.subject: GRanges subset by name column
parts:
Dear all,

 

I have searched over the last few hours on the web and I could not find a solution or a solution which I can understand.

 

I have read in my bed file:

P.obj=read.transcript.features("hg19.EnsemblGenesP.bed",up.flank=500,down.flank=100)

 

From this Granges List there is a character column containing the Gene names/IDs , I want to extract/subset a particular set of genenames/IDs that is provide in a R object.  The list of genes is an R object called “plus” where the header of the column is “name”.  I want the extract/subset P.obj so that the output remains as a Granges list.

 

I don’t want to manipulate the bed file prior to reading the transcript features, as I will need to do this operation many times with different gene lists.

 

BW,

Michelle
